result:
Each query is a first attempt from the page alone, and none of them has been run.

- **Guesses:** M2, M8, M9 and M13 assume `round` takes no argument (rounding to 1 or 2 decimals is done as `mul 10`/`mul 100`, `round`, `div`) and that `sum` of an empty vector is 0. M3, M5, M9, M10, M13 and M14 assume `groupBy` keys must be keywords, so I convert keys with `keyword`. M13 assumes `parseJson` reads a numeric string as a number.
- **No regex:** M14 turns `.` and `;` into spaces with `split`/`join`, then splits on spaces and drops the empty strings.

M1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: filter ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age | type | eq ::number) * /profile/age | :xs / | sum | div (xs | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: filter ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | ne null) | groupBy ~(/profile/country | upper | keyword) * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels * lower | contains "bug") | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 * /id
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned" | keyword) * count
M6: * /labels | flat * lower | distinct | sort
M7: /dependencies | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :version (/1 | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))} | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~([(/status | eq "paid") (/status | eq "shipped")] | any ~(eq true)) * /items | flat * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/customer | keyword) * (* (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2
M10: /services | filter ~(at :tls | coalesce {} | at :enabled | eq true) | entries | sort ~/0 * (/1 | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2 | keyword) * count
M12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~([(/1 | eq "WARN") (/1 | eq "ERROR")] | any ~(eq true)) | filter ~(drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout") * /2 | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :xs / | sum | div (xs | count) | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split "." | join " " | split ";" | join " " | split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) * lower | groupBy ~(keyword) * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
